plan.why: Fort McAllister is the only paid stop on this day and the longest, and it sits just past the lunch places -- where the boys have already been out of the car for the best part of an hour. Skipping it is also what turns a day that ends after dark into one that ends in daylight.

notes.sob: Fuel, restrooms and a stretch under the sombrero. You get there before the tower, the arcade and the shops open, which is what keeps the stop short -- the Pantry and its restrooms are the part that is open.
notes.santee_mound: This is the earthwork fort you still get, and with the big one dropped it is the only walk on the day -- which is why the closures below are the one call worth making.
notes.lunch_richmond_hill: Four places within a few minutes of exit 87: a sit-down bistro, a grab-and-go counter, a barbecue joint, and a supermarket if you would rather picnic in the park. Three of the four publish hours I could check against your arrival; the supermarket does not. This is also now the stop where the boys get out properly.
notes.jesup_trains: Twenty minutes on the chance that a train comes through where three lines meet -- luck rather than a timetable, and a short enough bet to lose. Use the restrooms at lunch, not here.
